title: Mermaid Princess Lara
overview: Grace, the banished witch, gives Lara, a mermaid princess, a potion that turns her into a human.

title: Running Through Shiga
overview: Lara wakes up in the human world in Shiga and encounters Grace in pet fish form, kept by Mari.

title: Look Away and You Lose
overview: Lara is curious about "school," and Mari fights her senior to participate in the next boxing tournament.

title: The Princess and the Prince
overview: Lara convinces Mari to take her to school and meets Himeka and asks her about her "prince."

title: I'm Willing to Die for Cake!
overview: Lara and Mari get hired at a bakery. Lara struggles with the pressures of the job and finding her prince.

title: The Light That Shines on Me
overview: Lisa's and Kota's past and how they became humans are revealed.

title: Meet Me at Biwako Terrace Saturday at 10
overview: Lara encounters Luca, a boy who looks exactly like the prince she once loved.

title: The Night of the Final Match
overview: With the finals of the boxing tournament looming, Mari realizes that she has little time left for Lara. While Mari meets Lisa, Lara begins to not feel well as her time is about to run out.

title: True Love
overview: Lara feels the pressure to find true love as the witch's magic is running out. Is Luca the one?

title: The Princess With a Blade
overview: Lara's family starts to awaken as the witch's magic is lifted. They are desperate for Lara's light.
